text: Screen 1 Welcome: START button + Continue with your existing account (login optional link). Leap Fitness brand.
Screen 2 gender: Male/Female cards, no skip visible
Screen 3 main goal: 6 options single-select + Next; progress bar ~10%
Screen 4 focus areas: 8 chips multi-select + Next
Screen 5 height: vertical ruler, default 175 cm, cm/ft toggle
Screen 6 weight: horizontal ruler default 75 kg (kept), kg/lbs toggle, BMI 23.7 shown
Screen 7 target weight: ruler default 72 kg (kept; odd for build-muscle goal)
Screen 8 fitness level: 3 options
Screen 9 Estimate your 1RM: benchmark exercise picker (Bench Press), weight field 30 kg, reps 5 -> 1RM 35 computed; skip link I m a beginner and I don t know
System numeric keyboard opened, cursor lands mid-text; existing value not selected
1RM estimated 76 kg from 60x8
Screen 10 frequency: 3/4/5 days/More options + week start day (7 options); Next disabled until both chosen
Screen 11 equipment: All/Barbells/Dumbbells/Kettlebells/Weight Machines/None
Screen 12 location: Large Gym/Small Gym/Garage Gym/At Home
Screen 13 biggest challenge: 3 options
Next does nothing until an option is chosen (required)
Screen 14 How would you like to train: I want a plan / still figuring / I train my way (Just need a simple way to log) -> chose I train my way
Screen 15 fake loading Tailoring Your Experience (4 progress bars, ~6-8 s forced wait, 4.9 rating badge)
Screen 16 Your Custom Setup Is Ready: weight curve 75->73 kg in 4 weeks, About You, Start Now
AD #1: full-screen interstitial (Google AdMob, shows Test Ad on emulator) right after Start Now; close X appeared top-right after ~5-8 s
Onboarding done: landed on Custom tab (empty state Create your first custom workout + START). No paywall, no permission prompt, no login so far.
Rate-us dialog (5 stars + RATE) popped right after adding the first exercise to a custom workout, ~3 min into app use; dismissed with back
Backup & Restore = Google account chooser (Google sign-in -> cloud sync); not signed in, dismissed
First workout start shows a coach-mark guide with an (Example Exercise) 5x20kgx5, Skip Guide button top-right (consumed in explore, so T1 will not show it)

Guide = 7 coach marks (Hello, Log next set, Log a set checkbox, More actions, rest timer off by default, Edit your plan (sets 30x3 demo), Log all sets ALL) + I got it! => ~8 taps if followed, 1 tap via Skip Guide
AD #2: interstitial after QUIT (discard) workout
AD #2 close X visible at ~5 s

No empty/quick workout exists: the app flow is build-first (Custom tab -> START builds a custom workout New training 1 in Edit mode, then SAVE, open, START). Exercises added in the builder via multi-select dialog.
system keyboard (text) opens for search
Bench Press · Barbell is 2nd result under Bench Fly · Dumbbell
search clear X is 16x16dp; ADD n EXERCISES button floats above keyboard at y~717 overlapping the 3rd result row
Chest Dip row partly hidden behind the floating ADD button; tapped its upper edge
with keyboard open the result list is clipped at ~3rd row by a selected-exercise thumbnail tray + ADD button; must close keyboard to reach Chest Dip
keyword cable gives 63 results with no chest fly in first screen (cable fly / crossover give 0: search is substring on name, names are X Fly · Cable); used chest fly, found in explore
builder: each exercise added with 1 empty set; left at defaults
workout opens with first exercise expanded, 1 empty set row (KG / Reps), no prefill; warm-up set type does not exist -> logged 40x10 as normal set
app keypad (not system): digits, dot, backspace, hide, Next, plate-calculator key
set logged: row turns green, no rest timer (off by default), app auto-expands next exercise because bench had only 1 planned set; FINISH appears in header
FRICTION: after Add a set the app keypad stays/opens but focus is on Incline set 1 KG (the field focused after previous LOG), not the new bench set 2; typed 60 into wrong exercise, fixed
focusing a field shows a Recently used: 40 kg x 10 Reps chip (tap to fill)
new set row shows previous values greyed as hint; typing replaces
TRAP: in s2 Next moved focus to Reps which held copied 10 with caret at end, typing 8 gave 108 and set was logged 60x108 (my error not caught before LOG); fixing now (voided)
direct tap on a field selects its content (typing replaces); keypad Next does NOT select (typing appends) -> fixed set 2 to 60x8; redoing s3 cleanly
Add a set copies previous set values (shown grey until done)
after LOG, app scrolls to next exercise whose set is empty and auto-opens app keypad on its KG
new bench set added offscreen above the viewport; had to scroll up to reach it
keypad already open with focus on Incline set1 KG (auto)
Chest Dip is reps-only (no weight field): BW and +10 kg cannot be recorded; logging reps only
set 3 should be +10 kg x 8: weight impossible on Chest Dip; logged 8 reps
E5 s3 went wrong: reps tap while keypad open did not move focus (list had re-scrolled), result 17.51x15 logged; voided whole s3 and redoing

FRICTION/BUG: switching from KG to Reps by tapping while app keypad is open is unreliable here: first tap did not move input focus (digit went to KG -> 17.51, toast Character limit reached), second tap focused Reps but appended to copied 15 -> 1512. Voided; redoing
Next to Reps keeps copied 15 with caret at end; one backspace -> 1, then 2 -> 12

FINISH (header, 76x28dp) goes straight to result page, no confirm: TOTAL WEIGHT LIFTED 5678 kg (= sum of logged sets; dumbbell weight counted once, not x2), share row Instagram/WhatsApp/Save Image/Copy text/More, FINISH button
Update your workout? dialog: diff of template vs done sets per exercise (0 kg x 0 -> logged values); Update all changes / Keep current -> chose Update
after finish: lands on Report tab; no ad shown at finish this time
cold launch: blue splash with progress bar ~5-8 s (ad-loading style), lands on last tab Custom; no app-open ad seen
T3: Custom tab -> template card -> START; all 20 sets prefilled from template (updated at T1 finish), not from history; no last-time column
bottom FINISHED button (354x51dp) also finishes once all sets done; result card WELL DONE 2nd workout, 20 sets 5678 kg
tap done set KG -> app keypad, content selected; Recently used chips: 60x7, 60x8, 40x10
edit saved in place (no confirm), set stays done
swipe-left Delete removes the set instantly: no confirm, no undo/snackbar; no undo anywhere (only unticking a done set)
no Squat in this workout; reorder target = move Overhead Press above Incline
reorder: long-press exercise header and drag (no visible handle), works; dropped above Incline
exercise menu: Add memo, Replace, Rest Timer Off, Remove exercise, Create Superset
home + relaunch after 5 s: back in workout, state intact, timer kept running
after force-stop: splash ~8-14 s, then Custom tab with resume bar at bottom: New training 1 03:10 + Continue
workout fully recovered incl. edits/deletions

in-workout: tap exercise thumbnail -> bottom sheet INSTRUCTIONS/RECORDS; RECORDS: BEST 1RM 76, MAX WEIGHT 60, MAX VOLUME 3560 (both same-day sessions summed), 1RM bar chart per day, HISTORY per session with sets grouped and per-row 1RM; DONE closes
second QUIT: no ad (interstitials appear frequency-capped)
search opens RECENT list; Bench Press visible without typing
search field auto-opens system keyboard covering the lower RECENT rows (Bench Press row hidden under keyboard)
same INSTRUCTIONS/RECORDS sheet (with video play button ivPlay)
no data export (CSV/JSON) anywhere; Backup & Restore only offers Google account sign-in (cloud sync); stopped at account chooser
custom exercise: name/photo/bodypart/equipment; no tracking-type choice; Weighted Dip with Dip Machine equipment still reps-only
plan Day 1 workout: weights prefilled from 1RM (e.g. 60 kg x 8, 4 sets)
